steps.name: Collect coupons (1)
steps.objective: After talking with [Noel] in the “Underground City of Tartarus,” complete the quest with [Titi] in the “Deborah Snowfield.”

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Hello, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How have you been, Noel?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Thanks to your concern, I was able to work hard between Luman and Tartarus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did I do?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Please help me talk a lot with Mr. Melvik, and ask Beynon to help me meet Merrymel at the midway point in Adrika... .

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: You are gaining a lot of trust from Mediah.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Come to think of it, the Kali people talk a lot about trust.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Medea asked me to say hello.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Medea is also curious about me. Yes, I am fine too, please tell me not to worry.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Someday, when I open my own business and open a store, I will definitely invite you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I really hope so.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Nothing else happened...)

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Oh, this is a gift.
(Noel takes something out of his pocket and gives it to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: I found this item by chance, and it's a special gift for you! I picked this up lying around on the black market in Jude Kingdom.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a seal. Uh, there's nothing engraved on it?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Yes, I looked up an old book and it says that if a person trusted by a spirit does a good deed, he or she can borrow the spirit's help and use it.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: (Noel stares at the seal.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Noel, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: It's nothing. Anyway, I'll give it to Adventurer, who knows a lot of spirits. Because you are my VIP!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Noel.
(An unknown energy is felt in this ordinary-looking seal.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I meet a spirit on the way, I'll ask it.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Not an acquaintance, but a familiar spirit... . It's fascinating.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have something to see in another town, so I’ll go there.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Where are you going?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is Gerda. Deborah I have someone to meet in the snowfield.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Wow, Gerda!! I have never seen snow since I was born. So I really wanted to go there at least once. I heard it's a really cool place.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Not now, but I will go later when there is a time when it is not dangerous to go alone!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It will definitely happen that way.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: You seem to be busy, so please go quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Noel. See you later then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then let’s go to Deborah Snowfield where Titi is….)
(Noel watches blankly until %s disappears.)

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: That seal, it's just a coincidence, right?  It's not like a spirit came and used it without me knowing... .

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Adventurer. Be careful before that... I wanted to say that, but you missed it again.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Excuse me, how many times did you miss while you were here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a shame, but three times while I was here.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Three times is good.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Hehe, I've probably done it more than 10,000 times by now. It's okay now, but when I first came here, I missed it dozens of times a day.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: About 360 years have passed... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: 360 years… ? Oh, by the way, I said that Kali village was not originally in Adrika.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: By the way, I heard that %s prevented something bad from happening to Gerda last time. Thank you again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: By the way, what brought you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea asked me to say hello to her and say she is well.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Eh, Medea? A kid who has never been like that before?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don’t think there was anyone who referred to Medea as a child, but ah… there was that witch.)

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Wow, I can't believe that Medea asked me to say hello and say she's doing well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it that much?

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Yes, Medea is so kind... . I guess things change over time.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: When he disappears... . But what was his name? I am… .

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: … I don't remember very well. It's strange, I haven't forgotten Medea's name, but I can't remember her name... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Yes, it’s not like it hurts or anything, right? Is it because you're hungry? Sometimes, when I'm chased by Bingdal, I get dazed.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: At times like that, you just have to eat the food Galette prepares... . Oh, is it because of Bingdal?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...something is definitely going on...)

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Sister Io said she would take me to Cali later, so I should meet Medea then. Since Medea had decided to hide the village, even I, a member of the Kali tribe, could not find it.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: By the way, is there anyone in Cali who remembers me now other than Medea? .

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Don't worry about this. Adventurer, I don’t think you’ll be staying here forever… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have something to ask Narin when I go to the village.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: I see. Be careful on your way. Adventurer tends to miss out more than others... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go. Aaaaa!!

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Look, you're slipping down there again... . But what was that thing that kept shining in Adventurer's pocket? Is it like a gem?

steps.name: Collect coupons (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Liriope] at “Fountain of Echoes” and obtain <Coupon of Trust>. Then report to [Narin] in 「Gerda」.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Uh, %s. How come you came alone? Where is Io... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Io said he was going to meet Adkina. I came from Kali Village to say hello to Titi... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Is that so? But the fact that you came to me means that something has happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, a Kali merchant named Noel gave me these. In an old book, it is said that it is a seal used by a person who is trusted by a spirit and uses the spirit's help when he or she does a good deed.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It's shining.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this shining? I don't know... , please accept it first.
(As soon as the seal is placed in Narin's hand, the light Narin mentioned clearly enters his eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, it was this kind of light.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hmm, did you happen to meet a spirit while coming here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. If there was a spirit, the only one was Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hmm… , Is that so? Normally, things like this rarely shine... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how can I use this stamp?
(Narin unfolds the scroll he was holding.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I'll give it a try. ah… . Since it wasn't printed on my scroll, it seems like it has another use.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Ah! Good deed coupons are coming! Good deed coupon!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? A good deed coupon?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Now I get an idea! For kids like me, it seems like a young spirit gave us this stamp a long time ago, praising us every time we did a good job!

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: For example, if you stamp a good deed coupon ten times, you will be given a gift, or you can change from an apprentice spirit to an official spirit... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: However, as the old book says, I don't know how to use it for humans. And where is that coupon? . ah!

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I remember a lot of coupons falling into the spring of echoes... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a fountain of echoes... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: If you get that coupon, it might help Adventurer somehow... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then how many copies can I get?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I think three pieces would be enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will go and look for it.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It's not urgent, so please take your time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (At first, I just asked how they were and got a stamp, but it feels like something is continuing. So, shall we go as soon as things are sorted out...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (By the way, do I get something if I stamp the coupon?)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: %s, I really had no idea it would be like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't know that existed either. Narin, here’s the coupon… .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I think one of the three is from Liriope's coupon.
(Narin takes the coupon and looks sad as if she felt something.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: What the child wanted to borrow... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I think it was a repentance from the master he trusted and followed.
(Narin lifts the stamp she was holding and stamps it on the coupon that was said to be Liriope's. Then, the coupon slowly turns into water droplets and scatters and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: … Well done. Hey… . Let’s meet again later with a new look. Not a Liriope for Eco or anyone else, but a Liriope just for you.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I will remember this Narin who was your family.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are now two chapters left.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I will keep one and make it like the other spirits had. So, if I do something good or something good happens, I try to share it.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: And the other one I will give to Adventurer now. You have done a good deed, so please receive it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's difficult to call it a good thing, though.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: That's enough. Now, take it.
(Narin hands a coupon filled with stamps to %s and inserts the other coupon into the scroll.)
(Surprisingly, a coupon placed inside the scroll slowly glows and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I don't know what this coupon will give you, but it may help with what %s is looking for right now.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Since he came to meet the Kali people, perhaps something related to him will appear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you know?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: You said he was a Titi and Kali merchant, so I just assumed that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, can I at least make a wish to God?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: %s, please do as you wish.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will give it a try.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Close your eyes while holding the coupons Narin gave you in both hands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s a strange feeling….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As if Iris would give the answer...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (An unknown image appears in my head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A rock? It’s moving… Golem? It looks like it has an ego… Is it someone’s command?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The name of the figure comes out of your mouth without you realizing it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Madori? anyhow!

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: What is Madhuri?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maduri, or rather, what is Maduri… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Explain to Narin that Madori is a magic golem that a certain girl carries around.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It is rare for a golem to have an ego.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I am Madhuri, no… . I'll go to Madori's owner.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Ah, %s. May I keep this seal in the future?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. I think Narin needs it more than me. Still, I will tell you that Noel gave me this item because he believed in me, so I entrusted it to the Spirit King.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Please tell me that the owner of the golem called Maduri will have the protection of the spirits.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. Then, Narin, I will go.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It's me %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Oh, no. I'll tell you again later. I need to think about it a little... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go. Narin, thank you.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: No. I am more grateful. Well then, good luck on your way.
